asks: The Calgary-Edgemont MLA asks the commission to keep the interim Calgary-Edgemont configuration and to add one more seat in Calgary.
Asks the commission to revisit the interim Mackenzie riding and the eradication of Lesser Slave Lake, keeping communities with their High Prairie and Slave Lake service hubs.

quote: it is difficult to understand why the already vast and geographically complicated constituency of Lesser Slave Lake has been eradicated and replaced with the proposed Mackenzie constituency
note: Objects to dissolving Lesser Slave Lake into Mackenzie (rule 4); asks only that the commission revisit the boundaries, so want is direction.

asks: Asks that Okotoks not be added to a Calgary riding.
Asks that Lethbridge's boundaries be left as they currently are.

quote: Please leave Lethbridge’s boundaries as they are currently written
note: One-line message; keeping the current two city districts is L1.

asks: Asks that Calgary ridings stay within the city and that one more Calgary riding be added.
Asks that Lethbridge stay urban and not be joined to large farming areas, though suburban areas could be added.

quote: growing progressive voices in the cities of med hat & Lethbridge that should not be silenced by adding large farming areas but could take in suburban areas
note: Pleased with the interim report; rejects joining the city with rural farm areas in general, not the four-way plan by name.

asks: Asks that Okotoks stay with Diamond Valley/Highwood and not become part of a Calgary riding.
Asks that Chaparral not be split between Calgary-Shaw and Calgary-Fish Creek, suggests adding Heritage Pointe to Calgary-Shaw, and asks for a new seat in south Calgary.
Asks that Calgary-Hays keep its existing boundaries and not absorb adjacent rural areas.
Asks the commission to take a regional approach in southern Alberta that ties Lethbridge to surrounding communities such as Coaldale, Coalhurst and Raymond.

quote: I encourage the Commission to continue considering a regional approach to electoral boundaries in southern Alberta—one that recognizes the interdependence between Lethbridge-East, the City of Lethbridge as a whole, and surrounding communities.
note: Asks for city-country districts around Lethbridge as a design, without particulars; direction only. Likely a template letter.

asks: Supports the interim map, in particular the new Edmonton-West-Enoch district and the urban-rural separation around Edmonton.
Asks that Springbank be included in the Calgary-Bow constituency.
Supports the interim Edmonton-Highlands-Norwood map and urban-only ridings, and asks for a further seat for Edmonton.
Asks that Lethbridge get another seat of its own and that its ridings not include surrounding rural areas.

quote: Lethbridge needs another seat just for itself, it should not include rural districts around it.
note: Wants an additional city-only seat (three urban seats, no hybrid); no listed option is three city-only districts for Lethbridge, so L9. Rejects any joining with rural districts.

asks: Asks that Calgary-Hays remain unchanged and that areas west of Deerfoot Trail not be moved to Calgary-Peigan.
Asks the commission to keep the interim proposal of two urban ridings for Lethbridge East and West.

quote: I would like to encourage the Boundary Commission to keep what was proposed, the 2 ridings for East & West Lethbridge to avoid competing interests
note: Argues that combined rural-urban boundaries create competing priorities, but in general terms; no explicit rejection coded.

asks: Asks that Okotoks not share an electoral division with Calgary.
Asks the commission to limit the use of the 25% variance so that growing urban populations are not under-represented.
Asks that Beaumont not be split and remain whole in Leduc-Beaumont.
Agrees with the interim report that Lethbridge East and West should not be split into four ridings with rural corridors.

quote: I am generally in agreement that the ridings of Lethbridge East and West should NOT be split into 4 separate ridings, incorporating several rural corridors.

asks: Asks the commission to reject the new Calgary-Confluence seat and put the new seat in south/southeast Calgary instead.
Asks that Okotoks stay in the Diamond Valley/Highwood riding and not join a Calgary riding.
Supports the interim decision not to create hybrid districts for Lethbridge and asks that it be maintained.

quote: I would like to support the Commission's approach to opt out of pursuing a hybrid electoral district for Lethbridge.
note: Also: 'these hybrid electoral systems in Lethbridge and its surrounding areas would do both communities a disservice' (p. 103), the basis for rejects; rejects hybrids for Lethbridge in general, not the four-way plan by name.

asks: Asks that Lethbridge not be divided into four ridings with rural areas and stay with two MLAs.

quote: Lethbridge does not need to be divided into four electoral regions which would include large areas of rural ridings. We are a small city and are easily managed by two MLAs.
note: The four-way idea is on no interim map; reacting to it as a circulating proposal.

asks: Asks that Lethbridge not be divided into four and that its ridings be left as they are.

quote: Dividing the Lethbridge riding into 4 is ineffective and designed to shore up support for the UCP. Leave the riding as as they are.

asks: A Calgary-Acadia constituency assistant asks that Manchester stay in Calgary-Acadia and that Lake Bonavista not be added to it.
An Edmonton-Gold Bar constituency assistant objects to the Edmonton core losing a riding through the merger of Riverview and Glenora, citing growth and undercounting.
Asks that Springbank be included in the Calgary-Bow constituency.
Supports the interim move of Whitehorn and Temple from Calgary-Falconridge to Calgary-Cross, including Conrich in Calgary-Cross.

note: Chestermere named only in discussing whether Conrich should align with it rather than Calgary-Cross; nothing about Chestermere itself sharing a district with Calgary.

asks: Asks that Springbank be moved into the Calgary-Bow electoral division.
Asks the commission to add another seat within Edmonton.
Asks that Lake Bonavista remain in Calgary-Fish Creek and that the new seat be created at Calgary's southern edge rather than as Calgary-Confluence.
Asks that Lethbridge not be split into four ridings with surrounding rural communities.

quote: I don't believe it is wise to split Lethbridge into 4 ridings. It would be difficult for a MLA to represent the diverse interests
note: Rejection only; nothing asked for in its place.

asks: Asks that Lethbridge not be split into four districts.

quote: Do not split Lethbridge into 4 districts. This will weaken Lethbridge and not accurately represent our needs.
note: Rejection only.

asks: Says there is no need to redraw the electoral districts at this time.

quote: I don't feel there is a need to redraw the electoral districts at this time.
note: Lethbridge identified only by the form header (municipality Lethbridge; about 70 - Lethbridge-West); the message may be about redistribution province-wide. Read as keep Lethbridge's current districts.

asks: Objects to the interim Calgary-Okotoks hybrid because urban and rural landowners differ.
Asks that Strathcona-Sherwood Park stay separate from Beaumont.
Objects to any proposal that adds rural areas to Lethbridge's urban ridings.

quote: I suspect it be an attempt to silence the more progressive voting areas by including more rural in urban ridings.
note: Lethbridge identified by the form header (about 70 - Lethbridge-West). 'The proposal' is not the interim map, which kept Lethbridge urban; read as the circulating hybrid idea. Rejection only.

asks: Asks that Lethbridge be left in its current boundaries with no changes.

quote: Please leave Lethbridge in the current boundaries. We do NOT want any changes.

asks: Asks that Springbank be moved from the interim Cochrane-Springbank division into Calgary-Bow, and that Canmore anchor its own Canmore-Rocky Mountain Corridor division apart from Banff-Jasper.

quote: Placing Springbank in Cochrane-Springbank severs these bonds, grouping it with more remote, horse-country communities north toward Cochrane
note: Objects to Springbank being with Cochrane, but says nothing about whom Cochrane itself should be with (Calgary or Rocky View); C1 is not rejected as a whole. Narrow coding (rule 17).
Airdrie named only as a growth pressure and in 'Airdrie-Cochrane splits'.

asks: Asks that the boundaries stay the same.

quote: Boundaries should stay the same. We don't need American gerrymandering in Canada.
note: Lethbridge identified only by the form header (municipality Lethbridge; about 70 - Lethbridge-West). Read as keep Lethbridge's current districts.

asks: Opposes the interim Calgary-Okotoks hybrid and asks for option 24B Okotoks-Diamond Valley, close to the current Highwood boundaries.
Agrees with the commission that Lethbridge should not be divided into four ridings.

quote: I agree with the commission's opinion that Lethbridge should not be divided up into four ridings
note: Writer lives in Edmonton; header gives 70 - Lethbridge-West as the target. Agreement with the interim view (two city ridings) read as L1.

asks: Supports the interim Calgary-Edgemont boundaries (Arbour Lake in, Hamptons out) and asks for more Calgary ridings that are urban, not hybrid.
Supports moving Temple and Conrich into Calgary-Cross and asks for one more seat for Calgary.
Supports keeping the Edmonton-McClung boundaries as in the interim map and asks the commission to rethink its view that Edmonton's population is declining.

The Rural Municipalities of Alberta ask the commission to use more of the population variance for rural ridings, add a riding in the northwest even with s. 15(2) exceptions, limit hybrid ridings with Edmonton and Calgary, and re-evaluate eliminating rural ridings.

note: Quotes the interim report on three far-northwest divisions 'reduced to two-and-a-third' and Slave Lake-Westlock-Athabasca, and asks for an additional northwest riding, but never names Lesser Slave Lake; not coded as K1 (rule 1, rule 17).

asks: Supports the decision to keep two Lethbridge ridings within the city rather than four urban-rural blended ridings.

quote: I would like to express my support for the decision to maintain two electoral ridings in the city of Lethbridge rather than amalgamating sections of the City with the surrounding rural ridings.
note: Rejection quote (p. 40): 'The proposal to fracture the southern ridings and create 4 urban/rural blended ridings would not have met the needs of the residents of southwestern Alberta.'

asks: Asks that the Calgary-West constituency be expanded to include the Tsuut'ina Nation.
Asks that Tofield be placed in Strathcona-Sherwood Park rather than Camrose (text ends mid-sentence in the source).
Supports the interim decision to keep Lethbridge's ridings within city limits, as with Red Deer, and opposes urban-rural blended ridings for Lethbridge.

quote: Both of Lethbridge's provincial ridings remain within the provincial average population, providing compelling evidence to retain the current municipal boundaries.
note: Rejects the round 1 proposals 'merging rural and urban ridings in Lethbridge and southern Alberta' (p. 47), in general rather than the four-way plan by name.
Red Deer's two city-only ridings cited as a comparison for Lethbridge (rule 6).

asks: Objects to merging Edmonton-Riverview with Glenora and to hybrid urban-rural divisions, asking the commission to account for Edmonton's projected growth.
Asks that Canmore be in the riding name and objects to grouping Banff and Jasper together in a stretched Banff-Jasper riding.
Asks that electoral boundaries not be moved.

quote: Electoral boundaries should not be moved
note: Whole message is six words. Lethbridge identified only by the form header (municipality Lethbridge; about 70 - Lethbridge-West). Read as keep Lethbridge's current districts.

asks: Asks that the Taber constituency run from Lethbridge County east to Bow Island along Highway 3, and supports the Lethbridge quad hybrid model giving the city four MLAs.

quote: As a solution, I support the Lethbridge quad hybrid model. Not only would this benefit the Taber Warner constituency, but it would give Lethbridge double the MLAs
note: Names the four-way hybrid plan circulated in round 1.

asks: Opposes splitting the two Lethbridge ridings into four urban-rural ridings.

quote: The current proposal to split the two Lethbridge ridings into four ridings that meld urban and rural constituencies will serve neither well.
note: Calls the four-way plan 'the current proposal', though the interim map kept two city ridings; rejection only.

asks: Asks the commission to explain openly any deviation from voter parity in northern Calgary ridings with many residents who lack voting rights.
Asks that the current Lethbridge-East and Lethbridge-West urban boundaries be kept.

quote: I am happy with the current electoral boundaries for Lethbridge East and Lethbridge West as they serve an Urban area and the City of Lethbridge the best.
